overview: Fatih is an idealistic History teacher who is handsome and honest. On the day he graduated from the university, Orhan appeared, who said that his father was his colleague, and explained to Fatih the facts about his family history, which he never knew; Fatih's father is an 'Akıncı Bey' of Ottoman ancestry and was martyred as a result of an assassination attempt. Fatih will continue this sacred duty that has been going on for centuries. Over the years, Fatih is trained with the help of Orhan and wages war against any criminal organization that poses a threat to his country. While teaching history during the day with an extraordinary understanding of education, he takes on the role of Akıncı by hiding his true identity with the mask he wears at night. With his operations, he turns into a folk hero day by day.
title: Akıncı

overview: Renata, Johan and Veronika share a friendship and a company where their spouses work. And a common murder. For a while, it seems that the girls start living their dream of a new happy life, but obstacles stand in their way. The ones anticipated in the form of an investigation by the consistent Brno criminologist Olina Nekula, but also the completely unexpected ones.
title: Černé vdovy

overview: Steve Carell stars in The Office, a fresh and funny mockumentary-style glimpse into the daily interactions of the eccentric workers at the Dunder Mifflin paper supply company. Based on the smash-hit British series of the same name and adapted for American Television by Greg Daniels, this fast-paced comedy parodies contemporary American water-cooler culture. Earnest but clueless regional manager Michael Scott believes himself to be an exceptional boss and mentor, but actually receives more eye-rolls than respect from his oddball staff.
title: The Office

overview: April, 1986. Pripyat, Ukraine. A core meltdown occurred at Reactor 4 of the Chernobyl Power Plant. Over thirty people died during the blast but the estimated death toll as a result of the radiation fallout will reach a four-digit number. This accident will be considered the world's largest ecological disaster. Set at ground zero of a catastrophe, this film will reveal the details of the Chernobyl event. The shocking news of the explosion at the nuclear plant has spread, as the world watched the tragedy in fear and confusion. Hearts went out to those who displayed selfless courage and integrity in the initial efforts to stabilize the reactor power. But some were too busy being in love to notice what had just happened in nearby Chernobyl. The disaster has faded into the background...
title: Мотыльки

overview: Eylül lives with her grandmother and earns her living as an escort. All she wants is to save enough money, move to Wales and create a new life there. One night she is summoned to a bachelor party by a group of friends who find her on Instagram. Eylül falls in love with the future groom Cem, who is counting the days to marry a socialite girl. Cem is also attracted to Eylül. After that night, Cem and Eylül's lives begin to mix.
title: Çıplak

overview: Journey to three of the most exotic, mysterious and remote islands on the planet: Madagascar, Borneo and Hawaii. Isolated from the rest of the world, they harbor remarkable wildlife and pioneering human communities found nowhere else on Earth.
title: Islands of Wonder

overview: Great Nature is an entirely new kind of natural history series that introduces some of Earth's most stunning vistas, shows how they were created, and reveals nature's marvels in a style that's bursting with detail.
title: Great Nature

overview: The Maritime Special Operation Forces (MARSOF) operate worldwide under the most extreme conditions to keep The Netherlands safe. These marines are very strong and after a very tough selection are trained for anti-terrorism and special operations. When all other options have failed, these men are the last resort. We tell the story of this special unit on the basis of never-before-seen visual material and very personal interviews.
title: MARSOF: Special Forces van Nederland

overview: Mel Giedroyc: Unforgivable invites three celebrity guests along to Mel's confessional each week to find out who's committed sins that are so bad that they should be declared 'unforgivable'. The competitive comedians will dare to sin it, to win it.
title: Mel Giedroyc: Unforgivable

overview: In order to avoid her mother meddling in her love life, Ye Xiao Bai joins a business project that strict boss Guan Yi He is running. The two end up falling in love and having a secret relationship because their workplace doesn't allow romance between colleagues. They end up marrying and establishing a family in secret, and Xiao Bai thinks life is going well, but the pressure of keeping their relationship a secret puts a strain on their family. Other problems arise both personally and professionally, opening Xiao Bai's eyes to the issues women face in the workplace and the struggle to balance work and family. The naive girl learns to be stronger, advancing at work and protecting her family and marriage.
title: Zhe Jiu Shi Sheng Huo

overview: Love might occur at the right time with the right person or at the wrong time with the right person, or both together. It might keep waiting, or not occur at all… Perhaps twice in a lifetime
title: Nimra Etnin

overview: Anuradha Chandra stabs her perfect lawyer husband one fateful night and confesses to her crime. However, it is anything but an open-and-shut case.
title: Criminal Justice: Behind Closed Doors

overview: Feluda Pherot is the return of the iconic Feluda, Asia's Brightest Crime Detector, along with his comrades Jatayu and Topshe, unraveling more mysteries.
title: Feluda Pherot

overview: Inimă de țigan is a story about love and passion, dreams and restrictions, ambition and failure. Codrut a young Gypsy man with ambitions to become a doctor and integrate the Romanian community, has to obey the traditions of his ethnic group. But he falls in love with Irina, a very rich and spoiled Romanian girl, whose father dreams of marrying her to a successful businessman. Since Codrut was promised by his father to a Gypsy girl and Irina is supposed to marry Luca, the man her father chose for her, their love seems impossible. So they have to fight everyone in order to be together. Inimă de țigan sheds light on the bohemian, traditional and romantic side of the Gypsy minority.
title: Inimă de țigan

overview: The plot follows the lives of two people who, at first glance, are connected only by their name - Kosta. First one, refugee from Krajina, is trying to survive, while other one is peacefully building a career.
title: Kosti

overview: The events revolve around the businessman, his wife, the housewife, their young child, the engineer and his wife, the Tango dance trainer. One of them had a terrible accident, which opened the door to the painful facts of love, betrayal and revenge. Will someone fall into a taboo?
title: Tango

overview: A New Year's rave party in Goa turns deadly for a bunch of video game developers who get killed in a shootout. Only two survive. What happens next?
title: Pubgoa

overview: The kings & queens of leftover cooking will take a leftover dish on an epic journey across two rounds. Each half-hour after party, our home cooks will compete in the ultimate food makeover, finding ways to give old leftovers new life, all in the hopes of winning a $10,000 prize! Join host Jackie Tohn and judges David So and Rosemary Shrager as they watch our contestants transform leftovers into delicious creations.
title: Best Leftovers Ever!

overview: Hermann has excellent prospects of winning the Nobel Prize in Economics. If only he hadn't died shortly before the award winner was announced. The dead don't win prizes.
title: Unter Freunden stirbt man nicht

overview: Riverdale is a bold, subversive take on Archie, Betty, Veronica and their friends from the comics, exploring the surreality of small-town life - the darkness and weirdness bubbling beneath Riverdale's wholesome facade.
title: Riverdale

overview: Zip code 2900 equals wealth, power and beauty. They got it all but what is the price.
title: 2900 Happiness

overview: Portraits of teenagers who became mothers at a young age. Following their struggles, ups and downs in their new life.
title: De unge mødre

overview: Milan, 1640. At the height of the Thirty Years War, the twins Albrizzi, Ippolito and Ferrante, are the heirs of their own family, both in love with the same woman, Livia Cornero, daughter of Count Cornero, a trusted man of the King of Spain and bitter enemy of their family. When the feud between the two families ends up leading to the death of the patriarch of the Albizzi and the ruin of the family, Ippolito by mistake ends up shooting Livia, apparently killing her. Shortly thereafter, before the two brothers can fight in a duel, the guards sent by Cornero arrive and arrest Ippolito, while Ferrante manages to escape. From that moment on, their lives are separated: Ippolito, escaping the death sentence and forced labor, after being arrested by the French is forced to choose between the gallows and becoming a spy, thus changing his name to Alexandre Du Bois and placing himself at the service of Cardinal Richelieu. Ferrante, on the other hand, after a series of vicissitudes, ends up in the Caribbean Sea, where, with the new name of Malasorte, he joins the crew of the ruthless and charismatic pirate Coda del Diavolo, of which he will first become the Second and, subsequently, the heir.
title: Caraibi

overview: Albano 1525. Princess Elena Campireali, after receiving a severe education in the abbey of Castro, is betrothed to Prince Savelli who in exchange ensures the cardinal's investiture to Fabio, Elena's brother. Elena however falls in love with Giulio Branciforte, a mercenary in the service of Cardinal Colonna, who wants to become Pope at all costs. After a series of vicissitudes, Elena marries Savelli believing Giulio dead, in 1527, German serfs, mercenaries known as Lanzighenecchi (Landsknechten) descend to Italy and attack Rome, causing chaos and disorder.
title: Il falco e la colomba

overview: Sandro Lorenzini, He's a good lawyer who is self-confident in what he does, in his private life he is uncertain and confused. The women in his life, The Wife Elisabeth, Mother of his daughter Chiare or a young and attractive journalist Lorenza. He can't decide. Each episode features a legal case from his law firm Levorani & Lorenzini.
title: L'avvocato

overview: Lord of the Chefs is the first culinary reality show in Bulgaria. Sixteen professional chefs and amateur chefs took part in Lord of the Chefs. A special committee of elite professional chefs gave the tasks to the contestants and monitored their performance. The participants in the Lord of the Chefs went through various tests. Cooking of game meat, working with nitrogen and making sushi were just some of the challenges they faced. They were required to show creativity, flexibility, quick decisions and imagination.
title: Lord of the Chefs

overview: The world of a 30 year old creative artist and copywriter is turned upside down when he finds a 6 month old baby boy on his bed with a note that says "Olá Pai" (Hi Daddy). With the help of his best friend, Vasco, Jose Manuel Queiroz (Ze Manel) sets out to discover if the baby is really his son and just which of the many women he's dated might be the mother.
title: Olá Pai

overview: Aho Da Elly Sar is a series that deals with the different problems women have been facing in Egypt, especially in the Southern parts, between the years 1918 and 2018, showing the difference in ideas and traditions.
title: Aho Da Elly Sar

overview: Separate episodes with 15 different topics, divided into 3 episodes per topic, discussing the relationship between men and women, the problems that occur between them, and how they can be overcome for the success of their relationship.
title: Naseby W Esmetak

overview: This anything-can-happen competition will bring culinary matchups to the streets as chefs come together for outdoor cookoffs while the neighbors supply the goods. Eager chefs will try to convince the folks at home to open up their fridges and hand over their ingredients. Chefs can use anything they get — provided it fits into a single bin, that is. It'll be a one-and-done Kitchen Crash, as there's no guarantee contestants will find exactly what they're looking for AND there's no chance to restock throughout the competition.
title: Kitchen Crash

overview: Christian Strand challenges five celebrities in Sløsesjokket: We throw too much, things have to last longer. This saves the environment and money. How are they going to make it happen?
title: Sløsesjokket

overview: A chronicle of the life of the Greek hero who after killing his three sons must perform five labors to repent.
title: Hercules

overview: They are the school's elected representatives, but have more than enough with themselves and each other.
title: Elevrådet

overview: In this humorous drama series, we enter the life of the nurse Merethe just after the youngest daughter has moved away from home, and a new phase of life begins.
title: Stolthet og forfall

overview: Can a dab of vodka, a little rølp and a good dose of amateur hockey break down barriers and create friendships? The happy hockey amateurs in Kirkenes Puckers think so.
title: Puckers

overview: Harley Diaz, an engineering whiz who uses her inventions to navigate life as the middle child in a family of seven kids.
title: Stuck in the Middle

overview: Based on the Jon Michelets book "Skogsmatrosen".
title: En sjøens helt

overview: Join the world of art, music, dreams and friendships when we follow the artist collective Broslo in their universe at «Californebu».
title: Broslo

overview: Tempting fate, fearless hosts Wigald Boning and Bernhard Hoecker ignore warnings and restrictions on various items to see what happens when they do.
title: Nicht nachmachen!

overview: An adaptation of Pride & Prejudice by Jane Austen, set in Republican China.
title: Four Ladies

overview: Writer and comedian Sara Pascoe is learning how to do the world's most endangered jobs, from ice-carving in Finland to climbing trees to making sweets in Cuba.
title: Last Woman on Earth with Sara Pascoe

overview: A guided tour of all things Channel 4 in a celebration of four decades of iconic TV shows, from live autopsies and award-winning documentaries to anarchic live shows and ground-breaking comedy.
title: Back to the...

overview: Marley's Ghosts has a very intriguing premise - Marley has a rare gift that comes with mixed blessings. She can talk to the dead, which sadly now includes both her husband Adam, her lover Michael as well as the local vicar. Dead awkward. So begins a bizarre ménage-a-quatre, with Adam, Michael and the vicar all moving in, albeit in ghostly form, to Marley's haunt, sorry, home. Naturally Marley isn't crazy about this new set up - but all looks rosy again when the ghosts convince her that they're just a figment of her overwrought imagination, and for a moment she really believes they've gone. But, no, these apparitions ain't evaporating - they're going nowhere.
title: Marley's Ghosts

overview: Spain, 1720. Clara Belmonte is a young woman from a well-off family who, after the death of her father, one of the most prestigious doctors of Madrid, will see herself sunk into absolute poverty. Fallen from grace despite her exquisite education, thanks to her prodigious cooking she manages to get a job at the duchy of Castamar, disrupting, with her arrival, the apathetic world of don Diego, the duke. However, the agoraphobia she is suffering since the death of her father will not be the only obstacle that Clara will face when she arrives to the property of the duke. He, since he lost his wife in an accident, lives isolated in his great mansion, surrounded by the servants. And although at the beginning Clara is not well received by the staff of the house, she will soon stand out thanks to her exquisite education and her cooking abilities, which will even surprise the duke himself.
title: La cocinera de Castamar

overview: A four-part exploration of the lives and work of Rasputin (Russian Healer and Mystic), Aleister Crowley (Occultist), The Marquis de Sade and John Dee (Elizabethan Occultist).
title: Masters of Darkness

overview: In the middle of the night, far north in Norway at Finnmarksvidda, the Sami teenager Elle Jannok is on her way home from a party, when she finds a cell phone ringing. The phone belongs to a missing girl, Sofie. A couple of days later, the local police discover Sofie's body in a caravan three hours south of Finnmark. Maja Angell, who is studying at the University of London, is defending her highly debated doctoral thesis on criminology & profiling as she hears about the murder case in her old home town in Northern Norway. She defies all warnings and leaves the University to travel North. She has a message for the local police: the man charged with the murder, is not the killer. But no one's willing to listen to her theories. Not until Maja dares to delve into her own most dangerous, repressed memories of childhood will she be able to stop him and soon she realize that the killer is closer than she ever imagined.
title: Outlier

overview: The Chouseishin Series is the name of a tokusatsu superhero TV franchise which debuted in Japan from 2003 through 2006.
title: Chouseishin Series

overview: The play is set in the turbulent period of the Republic of China in Shanghai. In a turbulent era, the forensic doctor Che Suwei and the gentleman detective Gu Yuan are intertwined with various forces. "Deputy Inspector Kang Yichen, and the innocent and lively reporter Cao Qingluo worked together to crack out a number of weird and curious cases, and restore the truth.
title: The Case Solver

overview: During a visit to his motherland, a Korean-Italian mafia lawyer gives an unrivaled conglomerate a taste of its own medicine with a side of justice.
title: Vincenzo

overview: A story that follows a man who returns from abroad but encounters a troublesome situation. By chance, he meets a single mom and secures himself a job as her after-birth caregiver. Shen Xin Wei who is exceptional at academics has become a rising star as an educator in North America. He is honest, righteous and principled but he gets framed for something that he did not commit. Out of anger, he leaves his life abroad and returns to China. However, his luck worsens as he runs into more troble such that his day to day living expenses have become a problem. Na Na is a white-collar worker. Shortly after registering her marriage abroad, she learns that the man she has fallen for has an impending marriage waiting for him in China. She realizes that she's pregnant and just as she prepares to become a single mother, Shen Xin Wei volunteers to be the nanny.
title: Mr. Nanny

overview: The California Department of Forestry and Fire Protection (Cal Fire) is dedicated to fire prevention and protection of California's privately and publicly-owned wildlands and is the lead agency battling the historic wildfires that burned across California this past year - the worst in the state's history. The men and women fighting on the frontlines are true heroes and now, Discovery Channel, in partnership with Cal Fire is bringing their battle against life-threatening blazes to viewers at home.
title: Cal Fire

overview: Drama about a deaf girl who witnesses the audacious murder of a policewoman, and is reluctantly propelled further into a loud and frightening world.
title: The Silence

overview: Mama Róza, the "Godmother", is the leader of the smuggling mafia, who, at the beginning of the story, on her 69th birthday, decides to retire within a year and gives control of the smuggler mafia to the mayor of the village, ie Makkosszállás. The election will be due in a year, so the nearby family members and the residents of the village are also starting to work - with more or less success - to get into the graces of Mama Róza and get the chance of getting the mayoral title as much as possible. They use everything. They know no bounds!
title: Keresztanyu

overview: The world of celebrity has been transformed since the turn of the century, driven by some of the most dramatic technological and cultural developments in recent times. This series charting the explosion in celebrity culture.
title: Celebrity: A 21st-Century Story

overview: O Clube takes place in the eponymous nightclub, located in the city center of Lisbon, and follows the story of 3 characters: the owner, security guard and the young girl.
title: O Clube

overview: Chatsworth House is an insight with unprecedented access to Britain's best loved stately home during extraordinary times. Each episode links stories and characters from this great house, the garden, parkland and the wider 35,000 acre estate.
title: Chatsworth House

overview: As a flower girl, Su Xiao Wan never really imagined her simple life would ever be anything other than ordinary. But when an accidental mixup lands her in a sibling contract with Gu Yan Xi, the young master of the well-known Gu family, her simple life is flipped upside down. Now obligated to play the part of Gu Yan Xi's younger sister, Xiao Wan finds herself tangled in the affairs of one of the most prominent business families in the land. Constantly hounded by Yang Xi's sharp tongue and ceaseless schemes, Xiao Wan is forced to rely on her quick wit and sly tricks, in order to survive. Never allowed a moment's peace, Xiao Wan can only find respite while in the company of Gu Zi Qian, the family's second master. A warm and caring young man, Zi Qian takes it upon himself to look after Xiao Wan, shielding her, whenever possible, from the constant pestering of his older brother. Unfortunately for Xiao Wan, Zi Qian's kindness is fueled by his own secret ambitions. Soon trapped in a complicated relationship with both Yang Xi and Zi Qian, Xiao Wan struggles to find a way out. As her head tells her to go one way, her heart tells her to go another; leaving Xiao Wan to wonder, which brother will ultimately help her find the happiness she desires?
title: A Love So Romantic

overview: An imaginary historical series, showing the stories of the kingdoms and their wars for the ambitions of governance and revenge. The series raises the question about the upper hand in the relationship between destiny and human.
title: Orchidea

overview: An adaptation of Raymond Khoury's novel about a New York archaeologist researching the lost secrets of the medieval Knights Templar.
title: The Last Templar

overview: Yaqut, a father, leaves his wife and kids and disappears for 20 years. The Devil, Wannous, then visits his family, pretending to be their father's friend, and tells them that he and their father have made millions. A conflict between the children and their mother ensues, and they need to choose between going back to their father and his money, or keeping things the way they are.
title: Wannous

overview: Based on legendary Egyptian novelist Naguib Mafhouzs novel. The series revolves around a theater group in the 70s who discover that the characters in their new script are actually themselves and that the script reveals all their secrets.
title: Afrah Al-Qoba

overview: Fortune Arterial's story revolves around the male protagonist Hasekura Kouhei, who transfers into a prestigious public school in the style of an English six-year school encompassing junior-high and high school students. The school is on an island named Tamatsu Island off-shore from mainland Japan, and the only way to get there is by boat. Soon after transferring, he discovers that one of the student in the class next door to his, Sendou Erika, is in fact a type of vampire.
title: Fortune Arterial: Akai Yakusoku

overview: Tayea, a doctor from Upper Egypt, refuses to take revenge for his deseased father, being threatened to be killed as well, he escapes by admitting himself in prison for a small crime he committed on purpose, until he learns that his brother is working with the biggest smuggler of ancient Egyptian artifacts 'Harby', so accepts to work as an informer to the police, leave prison, and work as an undercover in the smuggling business, claiming to 'Harby' that he is a "tracker" he can sense where artifacts are buried in tombs underground.
title: Tayea

overview: Bahgat Abu El kheir luxurious life changes entirely after he meets life's obstacles and what is it like to live in poverty.
title: Saheb al Saada

overview: A retired Egyptian officer working at the Egyptian embassy in Tel Aviv decides to plot revenge against Israel for freezing his bank accounts when he objected to its monstrous conduct in Palestine. In Egypt, he recruits five of his former students to rob Israel's largest bank.
title: Naji Attallah's Squad

overview: Amina decides to be independent, her family refused so she ran to participate in a weird competition, if she wins she'll get a scholaship and money.
title: Leh Laa?!

overview: In the Amazon, six investigators hunt for a city of gold and the answer to a chilling question: why do so many who chase the Akakor legend vanish? Follow the Curse of Akakor show page and be a part of the adventure.
title: Curse of Akakor

overview: Meadowlands focuses on a family trying to escape its past while confronting an even more uncertain future. The series picks up as Danny and Evelyn Brogan along with their two teenage kids enter a witness protection program and are moved to a bucolic neighborhood to begin a new life. Picturesque and crime-free, Meadowlands appears to be a suburban paradise where the Brogan family can begin to start a new life. But they soon realize that it's not so easy to escape the past and their safe haven becomes a world of paranoia and psychological intrigue with surprises around every corner.
title: Meadowlands

overview: The series is set around the human race's lust for power and the willingness of some people to offer sacrifices and violate divinity in their race towards it, depicting the story of a big family living in a village, and using mythological elements to tell the family's story.
title: The Covenant (The Permissible Speech)

overview: This comedy series tells the story of Nader, an ex-ambassador, who decides to leave the political field and start his own restaurant in a tourist hotspot where he cooks the meals himself.
title: Family Size

overview: Exploring the great forces of nature that support, drive and enable life on Earth.
title: A Perfect Planet

overview: Ke Ying is a talented economics lecturer who is forced to help psychopath Feng Xiao Sheng gain real power within his corporation. The street smart Xiao Wu is a police informant, and when he discovers Fu's company is laundering money with foreign bank accounts, he uses his position as Feng Xiao Sheng's right-hand man to collect evidence. He befriends Ke Ying, and the two work together to destroy the criminal organization.
title: The Controllers

overview: Despite Mazu and Wasim's success in finding Samir's character and get rid of him, both received new devices, which means that the game is still ongoing.
title: The Game

overview: Based on Sonallah Ibrahim's celebrated novel, A Girl Named Zat explores the social and political winds of change in Egypt starting from 1952, when the main character "Zaat" was born, all the way up to the present day.
title: A Girl Named Zat

overview: The series is made up of a series of interconnected relationships between different social strata, starting with Akram, an executive director of one of the big companies, his emotionally distressed wife, and Samir, a driver who also struggles with his own conflicts in the region where he lives , Or his partner Sony, who snoops on ladies' phones.
title: Haza Al Massa

overview: The series revolves around Adham Abdel-Jaber, the ambitious and powerful wrestler who has won many medals and awards, resigns for an injury he has suffered, passes through many difficult conditions and enters prison. He is accused of committing criminal acts and when he is released from prison, Repentance, is facing major problems with large gangs.
title: Lams Altaf

overview: Based on Iain Banks's best-selling novel, this romantic mystery follows Stewart as he returns to his childhood home and tries to discover the truth behind his best friend's death.
title: Stonemouth

overview: When Ebbo's father dies, he leaves behind a will that compels Ebbo to complete a list of tasks to be able to get his inheritance. Ebbo enlists his friend Semsem's help to complete the tasks.
title: El-Wasseya

overview: Nelly is a wealthy girl, and Sherihan is the opposite. They happen to be cousins, with completely different personalities. When they find out that they will be getting an inheritance from their grandfather, they put their differences aside to solve the 'Mickey Mystery' which should get them to the inheritance.
title: Nelly and Sherihan

overview: A thriller about five friends who, after their graduation from the AUC, start working for Professor Selim Mansour, who is involved in illegal activities. But in the wake of a murder, everything changes.
title: When We Were Young

overview: The acclaimed TV series from Egypt follows Amina, a smart, quick-witted and aspiring young woman whose life takes a sudden and unexpected turn.
title: Halawet El Donia

overview: Julia is an actress playing small parts, aspiring to take leading roles and prove herself as a star. She gets into character deeply, till she becomes the character she's playing for a period, which gets her into many comic situations.
title: Julia
